gateway_chokepoint.note: All three COMQUTOR Week2 LLM tasks (claim_batch_enrichment / alpha_classifier / structure_extractor) share ONE Week2LLMGateway instance per run, built once in routes_research.py:2337 and threaded through all three writers -- meaning they also share ONE per-run call budget (default max_calls=32, server-capped at 100), not independent per-module budgets.

real_call_sites.purpose: Enrich already-segmented claims with entities/factors/direction/confidence for LLM_STRUCTURED_AGENTS only (market/technical/sentiment/news/fundamental[s]_agent); claim/evidence/source_section returned byte-for-byte unchanged, validated by _validate_llm_batch_enrichment
real_call_sites.provider: whatever comqutor_alpha.llm/tradingagents.llm_clients client the gateway's model was built with (DeepSeek by default per research_profiles.py)
real_call_sites.prompt_source: Week2LLMGateway._TASK_INSTRUCTIONS['claim_batch_enrichment'] (week2_llm.py:27-35), embedded in invoke_json's own prompt template (week2_llm.py:170-174)
real_call_sites.fallback: per-batch deterministic enrichment (extraction_method=deterministic_splitter) -- never a whole-run crash, never silently drops a segment

real_call_sites.purpose: Disambiguate among >=2 deterministically-eligible Alpha candidates (select or defer); cannot create candidates, change admissibility, or produce a trading decision
real_call_sites.provider: same shared Week2LLMGateway model as CS-01
real_call_sites.timeout: shared gateway default (see CS-01); classifier_timeout_seconds=5.0 is a separate, unused-in-this-branch parameter for the non-gateway `classifier` callable path
real_call_sites.fallback: keeps the already-computed deterministic matched_alpha/status decided before the classifier ran (classifier_metadata status='fallback') -- never crashes, never returns 'unknown'
real_call_sites.trigger_condition: match_status != 'no_match' AND len(eligible_candidates) >= 2 -- this is the concrete 'ambiguity' definition in code; every other claim never reaches this call site regardless of gateway availability

real_call_sites.purpose: Extract evidence-backed factor-to-factor relation edges (causal/supportive/conflicting) from one claim's evidence text, restricted to that claim's own deterministically-extracted allowed_factors
real_call_sites.provider: same shared Week2LLMGateway model as CS-01
real_call_sites.fallback: per-claim deterministic rule extraction (_extract_edges, relation_grammar.py) -- never an empty-graph crash
real_call_sites.trigger_condition: llm_gateway is not None AND len(factors) >= 2, evaluated per claim
real_call_sites.call_frequency: per-claim (not per-agent-report, not per-run) -- called once per structured claim record with >=2 deterministic factors

real_call_sites.symbol: 12 native agent node functions (market/sentiment/news/fundamentals analysts; bull/bear researchers; research_manager; trader; aggressive/conservative/neutral risk debators; portfolio_manager) + 1 post-run reflection call
real_call_sites.line: n/a (see repo-wide inventory sub-agent report for exact per-file line numbers)
real_call_sites.purpose: TradingAgents' own native per-agent analysis/debate/decision generation -- upstream functionality, not a COMQUTOR addition
real_call_sites.model_source: comqutor_alpha/research_profiles.py fixed ResearchProfile registry for real web-submitted runs (default DeepSeek comqutor_deepseek_default_v1; alternate Anthropic comqutor_anthropic_medium_sonnet46_v1) -- HTTP requests cannot select provider/model directly
real_call_sites.prompt_source: each agent's own native TradingAgents prompt-builder function, with the COMQUTOR Structure Output Contract suffix appended at runtime (see canonical_prompt_injection.py) for the duration of the run
real_call_sites.structured_output: partial -- 5 of the 12 (sentiment, research_manager, trader, portfolio_manager, plus market via a different path) use bind_structured/invoke_structured_or_freetext (tradingagents/agents/utils/structured.py); the rest are free-text
real_call_sites.retry_count: unclear / underlying LangChain SDK default (no explicit COMQUTOR-side retry wrapper found)
real_call_sites.fallback: n/a -- this is TradingAgents' own native behavior, out of COMQUTOR's Development Plan scope
real_call_sites.note: Every one of these 12 agents' prompt is functionally modified at runtime by canonical_prompt_injection.py to also request a COMQUTOR_CANONICAL_RELATIONS JSON block -- see tradingagents_modification_audit.csv. This does not add a new LLM call (same single call each agent already makes), but it is a genuine prompt-content change, achieved via monkeypatch rather than a tradingagents/ source edit.

test_fake_call_sites: tests/test_structured_agents.py, tests/test_memory_log.py, tests/test_signal_processing.py -- unittest.mock.MagicMock() llm objects

dead_or_legacy_or_manual_only_call_sites.note: SignalProcessor.process_signal explicitly documents it no longer makes an LLM call; quick_thinking_llm constructor argument accepted only for backward-compatible signature, unused.
run_deepseek_smoke -> run_original_tradingagents_research: real, opt-in, manual DeepSeek smoke entrypoint. Not invoked by any production code path, tests only exercise it mocked.
Manual dev CLI script to verify a provider's native structured-output mode. Not part of any automated production or replay path.

cache_infrastructure.note: No Redis/disk/in-process cache wraps any LLM .invoke() call anywhere in the repository. The only functools.lru_cache found (tradingagents/agents/utils/agent_utils.py:78, resolve_instrument_identity) caches a yfinance ticker lookup, unrelated to LLM calls.
